captions.caption: A news report details a serious collision in Douglasville, Georgia, where a train struck a red car on the tracks. The segment begins with a “NEW DETAILS” graphic, then shows aerial footage of the accident scene with emergency vehicles and a wrecked car pinned against a train engine. The report uses a map to pinpoint the location at the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, and features a reporter on location to provide updates on the incident.

Standing at night in the area, Kiggins provides new details about the crash, with the map and the “TRAIN HITS CAR” headline remaining visible throughout the report.

The report then cuts to an aerial view of the incident, revealing a red car that has collided with a train on the tracks, with emergency personnel and a police vehicle on the scene.
